records.name: National Black MBA Association Philadelphia Chapter
records.summary: The Philadelphia chapter of a national professional network for Black MBA holders and students. Members can use its career network and job listings, and its Leaders of Tomorrow program works with high school students.
records.what_you_do: Join or renew membership, look through job opportunities shared by the chapter, support the Leaders of Tomorrow program, and check the event calendar.

first_step.how: Join or renew membership through the Join page on the chapter website, then ask the chapter which events are coming up
first_step.basis: Membership with dues is the way in, and the site does not show what an event is like before joining.

records.notes: Legal name: National Black MBA Association, Inc. The site is live with program pages, but no dated events or news were visible, and its /events page returned 404. Membership cost, email and phone are not published. Community focus is in the name only, so left blank. The IRS address is a P.O. box, so no location is shown.

records.name: National Coalition Building Institute of Philadelphia
records.summary: Listed in IRS records as a Philadelphia nonprofit tied to the National Coalition Building Institute. Its website did not load during our check, so what it does and how to join are not yet confirmed.
records.notes: No readable source. The listed website (www.ncbiphilly.org) does not resolve (DNS error), checked with and without www on 2026-10-08. Name and address come from the IRS list only. Summary, category and audience are placeholders based on the name, so the owner may want to hold this record until the group can be read.

records.name: National Freedom Day Association
records.summary: Promotes February 1 as National Freedom Day, a day meant to honor freedom for all Americans. The group works through education, civic programs, and community events, and its site lists ways to join, volunteer, or give.
records.what_you_do: Look through the events page, use the Get Involved page to join or volunteer, or email the group with questions.

first_step.how: Email nfda1941@gmail.com to ask about membership, volunteering, or upcoming events
first_step.basis: Membership and volunteering are listed with a contact email, but no events or meeting times are shown, so what a newcomer would attend is unclear.

records.notes: Fetched after a 301 redirect from the IRS-listed domain nationalfreedomdayassoc.org to nationalfreedomdayassociation.org, which carries the same group name. The site is working but has no dated events or news. The Philadelphia tie is only the IRS mailing address (P.O. Box 7452, 19101), and the site names no local activity, so check before showing. Social links on the site go only to the main social sites, so none are recorded.

records.name: National Organization for Women
records.summary: Listed in IRS records as National Organization for Women Inc, with a Philadelphia mailing address. The website in the record redirects to a site that is not the group's, so what it does here and how to join are not yet confirmed.
records.notes: No readable source. The listed website pennsylvanianow.org returned a permanent redirect to attackdemo.com, an unrelated domain. It was not followed, and no link to it should be published. The IRS list gives a P.O. Box (63759, 19147). Tags and audience are placeholders from the name. The national organization's own website was not read.

records.name: North American Guild of Change Ringers
records.notes: A national guild for bell change ringers across North America, per its site. The site names no Philadelphia band, tower or regular practice. The only Philadelphia item is a one-off event, the Fifth Annual Bruce Butler Memorial Ringing Weekend, March 19 to 22, 2027. The site points to a Find a Tower page for local bands; if that page lists a Philadelphia band, re-check. Newest dated item: a news article titled Ringing for the Semiquincentennial, dated July 2, 2026. The IRS address is a Philadelphia apartment, not a meeting place.

records.name: Paper Airplanes
records.notes: Judgment call for the owner. The site describes free online English, digital skills and professional courses for people affected by conflict and displacement, open to learners in many places. It names no Philadelphia activity, no classes with dates and no in-person location. The IRS mailing address is 627 S 8th St, Philadelphia (19147). Judged out_of_area on the site's own scope. Reconsider as publish if online, Philadelphia-registered groups should appear in the directory. The newest year on the page is 2025, used in statistics.

records.name: Philadelphia Space Interest Group
records.summary: A Philadelphia-area group for people interested in space. It keeps a blog and newsletters, and its website says to contact members for meeting details.
records.what_you_do: Read the group's blog and newsletters for space news, then contact a member through the site to ask about meetings.

first_step.how: Use the Contact Us or members page on the group's website to ask about the next meeting
first_step.basis: Meeting times are not posted, and the site points visitors to members for details, so the way in is unclear.

records.notes: The batch name is National Space Society, and the site domain points to that group. The chapter page calls the group the Philadelphia Space Interest Group (PSIG) and shows TBA for meetings and events, so meeting times are unknown. Newest dated item: blog posts dated Thursday, October 1, 2026, as written on the blog. The blog is linked from the chapter site. Membership cost is not published. Whether meetings are open to non-members is not published either.

records.name: Old City Business Collective
records.summary: Listed in IRS records as a Philadelphia nonprofit with an Old City office address. Its website did not load during our check, so what it does and how to join are not yet confirmed.
records.notes: No readable source. Both www and bare forms of oldcitybusinesscollective.org fail to resolve (DNS error), checked 2026-10-08. The name suggests a business association. If it only serves businesses, the verdict should be hide (out_of_scope) instead. Tags and audience are placeholders from the name.

records.name: Oporation Ava Inc
records.notes: The IRS list gives no website (NONE) and a 315 Market Street office floor as the address. One search for Oporation Ava with Philadelphia found no matching public page; the results were unrelated. No public way in was found, so this is hidden under the no-public-way-in rule. Reopen if a public page turns up. It may also be a business office rather than a group (not_a_group is possible).

records.name: Pennsylvania Registry of Interpreters for the Deaf
records.summary: A volunteer-run Pennsylvania group that supports sign language interpreters and works to improve communication access for Deaf, hard of hearing, and DeafBlind people. It holds regional summits, board meetings, and an annual membership meeting, many of them on Zoom.
records.what_you_do: Volunteer on a committee (the page says several are on hiatus), attend a summit or an online meeting, or apply for membership through the site.

schedule.text: Events listed for fall 2026: a regional summit and proposal sessions in the Pittsburgh area (Oct 9 and 10, 2026), a board meeting on Zoom (Nov 11, 2026, 7 pm), and the annual membership meeting on Zoom (Dec 5, 2026, 9 am).

first_step.how: Email president@parid.org to ask about volunteering or the next board meeting, or fill in the membership application on the site
first_step.basis: Membership and volunteer roles are published with a contact email, and upcoming events are listed with dates.

records.notes: A statewide group, included because Pennsylvania includes Philadelphia. Most listed events are in the Pittsburgh area or on Zoom, and no Philadelphia meeting place is named. The page shows no publication dates, so status comes from the future-dated event listings. Membership cost is not published. Community focus is not written as eligibility, so left blank. The X link on the page goes to a generic address, not a PARID account.

records.name: National Organization of Black Law Enforcement Executives (NOBLE)
records.notes: A national organization with 58 chapters in 6 regions, per its site. The site names Georgia and Washington Metro chapters, not a Philadelphia one, and lists no Philadelphia events. Its only dated event is the 50th Annual Training Conference in Dallas, July 24 to 28, 2026. Membership is open to anyone, with separate tiers for law enforcement and for others; cost is not published. The IRS address is a P.O. Box in Philadelphia (19101), which does not show a local group. The IRS website field reads Retired, so the national site was read instead. Re-check if a Philadelphia chapter appears.

records.name: NSBE Greater Philadelphia Professionals Chapter
records.summary: The Greater Philadelphia professionals chapter of the National Society of Black Engineers, a national group for Black engineers. Its site points to membership, events, and ways to support the chapter's mission.
records.what_you_do: Join through the chapter's membership page, check its events page for upcoming gatherings, or follow the chapter on social media.

first_step.how: Use the Become a member link on the chapter site to join, then ask the chapter which events are coming up
first_step.basis: Membership comes first, and the site lists no events, dues or meeting times, so what a newcomer would see is not clear.

records.notes: The site is live but thin: no dated events, news or meeting times, and the events page lists none. Membership cost and email are not published. Community focus is in the name only, so left blank. IRS legal name: National Society of Black Engineers.

records.name: Independence Hall Chapter, Daughters of the American Revolution
records.summary: A Philadelphia-area chapter of the Daughters of the American Revolution, a national women's society. The chapter promotes historic preservation, education, and patriotism, and it offers help finding a Revolutionary War ancestor.
records.what_you_do: Contact the chapter to ask about joining and its meetings, get help with a Revolutionary War ancestor search, or support its goals of preservation and education.

first_step.how: Email independencehalldar@gmail.com or use the chapter's contact form to ask about joining and the next meeting
first_step.basis: The site offers help finding a Revolutionary War ancestor, which suggests joining depends on proof of ancestry. Meeting dates are not on the page.

records.notes: The newest dated item is a 'Last updated 1/18/2024' note at the foot of the page. That is about the website, not a chapter event, so status is dormant on that evidence. Legal name: National Society Daughters of the American Revolution (IRS). The IRS address 1537 S 4th St (19147) is not confirmed as the chapter's meeting place, so no location is shown. Meeting times, dues and age rules are not published.

records.name: Papa Konga Foundation
records.notes: The IRS list gives a business name (jfk import export llc) in the website field, so it is treated as having no website. One search for Papa Konga Foundation with Philadelphia found no public page for this foundation; the results were for other foundations. No public way in was found, so this is hidden as private. Reopen if a public page turns up. The IRS address is 808 N 29th St (19130).

records.name: Parkinson's Creative Collective
records.summary: Listed in IRS records as a Philadelphia nonprofit with a Green Street address. Its name points to creative work connected with Parkinson's, but its website could not be read, so what it offers and how to join are not yet confirmed.
records.notes: No readable source. https://www.parkinsonscreativecollective.org fails the security check (TLS certificate expired), checked 2026-10-08. Tags come from the name only. If the group turns out to be a support group, the tags should move to support-recovery. Audience is a placeholder.

notes: Batch file 11.json holds 15 groups, not 11, so all 15 were processed. Search budget: 2 of 2 used, cap reached. Fetches: 19, including failed and redirected ones. No rate limiting seen. One stray call to a browser navigate tool was made by mistake during the run; it returned an error and no browser action happened. Four publish records (NCBI Philadelphia, National Organization for Women, Old City Business Collective, Parkinson's Creative Collective) have no readable source and no confirmed purpose, so they carry empty sources and should be held back by the importer. Judgment calls for owner review: national groups whose own pages show no Philadelphia activity are out_of_area (NOBLE, NAGCR, Paper Airplanes); PARID is published as a statewide group; National Freedom Day Association is published at low confidence because only its IRS mailing address is in Philadelphia; the Philadelphia Space Interest Group is treated as the National Space Society chapter; Oporation Ava and Papa Konga are hidden as private because no public presence was found.
